blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Malacañang on Tuesday denied Vice President Sara Duterte’s remark that the Marcos administration was behind the allegations against her. Palace press officer Claire Castro said the vice president should instead answer the accusations and present evidence in her defense. Castro noted that Duterte appeared to be blaming President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. because she could no longer answer the accusations. “Maybe that is what happens when you can no longer find a defense – you simply point fingers at somebody else,” Castro told reporters in Pasay City.
